prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts of the crash, who’s at fault, the insurance situation, and what kind of outcome you want (quick settlement vs. trial). I can help you find very strong local options, but first here are practical tips so you can choose the best attorney for your case:

What to look for
- Substantial car-crash experience and trial experience (not just intake lawyers).  
- Board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) is a strong plus.  
- Proven results (settlements/verdicts) in cases like yours.  
- Resources to handle medical experts and litigation expenses.  
- Clear fee structure (contingency fee usually 33–40% if no recovery, confirm who pays costs).  
- Good client reviews and responsive communication.  
- Willingness to take a case to trial if the insurer lowballs a fair offer.  
- Local courtroom experience and relationships with local experts (helps with negotiations and trials).

Where to search and verify
- Texas State Bar Lawyer Directory to confirm license and discipline record.  
- Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo for peer/client ratings.  
- Google/Yelp and local Facebook groups for client experiences.  
- Verdict/settlement databases or firm websites for sample results.

Important legal note
- Texas personal injury statute of limitations is generally 2 years from the date of the crash (exceptions exist). Don’t wait to consult an attorney.

Questions to ask at the free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?  
- Who will actually handle my case (attorney or paralegal)?  
- What’s your fee and who pays expenses?  
- What is your strategy and likely timeline?  
- Will you take my case to trial if needed?  
- Can you provide references from past clients?

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated Houston personal injury attorneys and give you a short, vetted list with contact info; or  
- Recommend attorneys who focus on major-injury or wrongful-death wrecks versus those who handle smaller soft-tissue cases.

Tell me a little about your case (neighborhood in Houston, severity of injuries, whether fault is disputed, insurer involved), and I’ll pull a tailored list of experienced local lawyers you can call.
